import oblique_scene_squared_expansion_CPU64_v1 as core

bud,prod,ref,orig,pins=core.retained();k='scene:thin_beyond_end/reverse0/wind0/box1'

assert rn==732 and r['retained_canonical_status']=='STOP_CANONICAL_PAIR_EXACT_SUM'
bad=dict(q,wavelength='500');v=core.audit(bad);assert v['status']=='STOP_INPUT'and v['reason']=='closed_selector'and v['RN_nodes_executed']==0
before=core.retained
def missing():raise OSError('SIMULATED_MISSING_PARENT')
core.retained=missing
v=core.audit(q);assert v['status']=='STOP_INPUT'and v['reason']=='evidence_integrity:SIMULATED_MISSING_PARENT'and v['RN_nodes_executed']==0
core.retained=before
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS',public_API_valid=1,public_closed_selector_STOP=1,missing_parent_SIMULATED_STOP=1,additional_native_sum_RN=rn,new_products=0,native_roots=0),sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
